sentences.en: Welcome to Green Vale Agricultural Park.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到格林韦尔农业公园。

sentences.en: As you know, we have only been open a week so you are amongst our first visitors.
sentences.zh: 如您所知，我们仅开放一周，因此您是我们首批访客之一。

sentences.en: We have lots of fascinating indoor and outdoor exhibits on our huge complex, spreading hundreds of hectares.
sentences.zh: 我们在占地数百公顷的巨大园区内设有大量引人入胜的室内外展览。

sentences.en: Our remit is to give www.TopSage.com Test 27 7553 P9 educational opportunities to the wider public as well as to offer research sites for a wide variety of agriculturists and other scientists.
sentences.zh: 我们的职责是为更广泛的公众提供教育机会，同时也为各类农学家及其他科学家提供研究场所。

sentences.en: rpSage.com Let's start by seeing what there is to do.
sentences.zh: 让我们先来看看这里有哪些可参观项目。

sentences.en: As you can see here on our giant wall plan, we are now situated in the Reception block . . here.
sentences.zh: 正如您在此巨型墙面地图上所见，我们现在位于接待楼——就在这里。

sentences.en: As you walk out of the main door into the park there is a path you can follow.
sentences.zh: 当您从主门走出公园时，会看到一条可供跟随的小径。

sentences.en: If you follow this route you will immediately come into the Rare Breeds section, where we keep a wide variety of animals which I shall be telling you a little more about later.
sentences.zh: 若您沿此路线前行，将立即进入稀有畜种区，此处饲养着多种动物，稍后我将为您作进一步介绍。

sentences.en: Next to this moving east ... is the large grazing area for the rare breeds.
sentences.zh: 紧邻该区域向东延伸的是稀有畜种大型放牧区。

sentences.en: Then further east . . . in the largest section of our Park is the Forest Area.
sentences.zh: 再往东……便是本公园面积最大的林地区域。

sentences.en: South of the grazing area and in fact just next to the Reception block is our Experimental Crop Area.
sentences.zh: 放牧区以南、实际上紧邻接待楼的，是我们的试验作物区。

sentences.en: In the middle of the Park . . . this circular area is our lake . . ..
sentences.zh: 公园中央……这个圆形区域是我们的湖泊……

sentences.en: These two small rectangular shapes here . .. are the Fish Farms where we rear fish for sale.
sentences.zh: 此处这两个小型矩形区域……是我们的鱼塘，用于养殖供销售的鱼类。

sentences.en: To the east of those is the marsh area which attracts a great many migrant birds.
sentences.zh: 鱼塘以东是沼泽区，吸引大量候鸟栖息。

sentences.en: In the south-eastern corner, beyond the marsh, is our Market Garden area, growing vegetables and flowers.
sentences.zh: 在东南角、沼泽区之外，是我们的市场园艺区，种植蔬菜与花卉。

sentences.en: ........•*••••••••••••-••••••••••••••••••••••*************************** All these areas can be visited by the general public for almost all the year although..
sentences.zh: 所有这些区域全年绝大部分时间均向公众开放……

sentences.en: please take note of the large signs at the entrance to each area which tell. . . which tell you when certain areas are being used for particular controlled experiments and are therefore temporarily out of bounds to the public.
sentences.zh: 但请注意各区域入口处的大幅标牌，上面会注明某些区域正用于特定受控实验，因此暂时不对公众开放。

sentences.en: You can see for yourself what a huge area the park a covers and a key question is always, how can we move around?
sentences.zh: 您可直观感受到公园占地面积之广阔，而一个关键问题始终是：我们如何在园区内通行？

sentences.en: Well you have a choice of means .
sentences.zh: 您可自由选择出行方式。

sentences.en: all environmentally friendly. cars are banned in the park.
sentences.zh: 所有方式均环保友好；汽车禁止驶入公园。

sentences.en: We have bicycles which you can hire behind the Reception block . . . here .
sentences.zh: 我们提供自行车租赁服务，地点位于接待楼后方……就在这里。

sentences.en: the healthy ones of you can go on foot and finally there's our electric tram, powered from solar cells.
sentences.zh: 身体康健者可步行游览；此外还有由太阳能电池驱动的电动电车。

sentences.en: You find more information about this at the front entrance.
sentences.zh: 有关电车的更多信息，请至正门入口处查询。

sentences.en: A good place to start on your tour is the Rare Breeds section.
sentences.zh: 您的导览之旅可从稀有畜种区开始。

sentences.en: We keep goats, sheep and hens and other kinds of poultry.
sentences.zh: 我们饲养山羊、绵羊、母鸡及其他家禽。

sentences.en: We are also thinking of bringing in cows and horses but we do not, as yet, have facilities for these bigger animals.
sentences.zh: 我们还考虑引进牛和马，但目前尚无容纳这些大型动物的设施。

sentences.en: The animals are fed in public twice a day and a short lecture given on their feeding habits and nutritional needs.
sentences.zh: 这些动物每天公开喂食两次，并配有简短讲座，介绍其摄食习性与营养需求。

sentences.en: These are very popular with the public but of course we mustn't lose sight of the main purpose of having this section, not as such to preserve rare animals but to maintain the diversity of breeds to broaden the gene pool for agricultural development.
sentences.zh: 此类活动深受公众欢迎；但当然，我们绝不能忽视设立该区域的主要目的——并非单纯保护稀有动物，而是维系畜种多样性，以拓展农业发展的基因库。

sentences.en: Green Vale changes with the seasons with different events happening at different times of the year.
sentences.zh: 格林韦尔随季节更迭而变化，全年不同月份均有不同主题活动。

sentences.en: May will be perhaps our most spectacular month with the arrival of the Canada geese and when our fruit trees will be in full blossom, but there are interesting events on all year round .
sentences.zh: 五月或许是本园最壮观的月份：加拿大雁群抵达，果树亦正值盛花期；但事实上，全年皆有精彩活动。

sentences.en: for example John Havers, our expert fly fisherman, is currently giving displays on the lake.
sentences.zh: 例如，本园专家飞钓手约翰·哈弗斯目前正在湖上进行垂钓演示。

sentences.en: Each of the sections has its own seasonal calendar .
sentences.zh: 每个区域均有各自的季节性活动日历。

sentences.en: please consult the summary board at the main entrance.
sentences.zh: 请参阅正门入口处的汇总公告板。

sentences.en: And the final section, as we return to the Reception blocks, is the orchard.
sentences.zh: 最后，在返回接待楼途中，您将抵达果园区。

sentences.en: Do take time to browse round our shop . . . there is a wide selection of books on wildlife, some of them written by local authors, and the history of farming, including organic farming, something which the park will be diversifying into in the coming months.
sentences.zh: 请务必抽空浏览我们的商店……店内有丰富多样的野生动物类图书，其中部分由本地作者撰写；另有讲述农业史（包括有机农业）的书籍——而有机农业正是本园未来数月将重点拓展的方向。
